nusmp.skill.sandalphon.description: The Archangel of the Executioner. Four passives (Executioner's Authority, Absolute Severance, Inevitable Demise, Judgment Gaze), five judgments (Judgment Bullet, Condemnation, Supreme Edict, Guillotine Cleave, Verdict of Ruin) and, once mastered, Final Judgment: a held channel that freezes one target in time and detonates all its Temporal Debt at five times its worth. Since 3.21.0 the judgments hit harder: the Bullet turns every boon it tears off into a wound, the Supreme Edict is a decree that hurts every hostile creature in reach, the Cleave grows with the Temporal Debt of its target and finishes a sigil-marked creature below a third of its health, and a Verdict of Ruin that runs out tolls once more for a last share of everyone inside.
nusmp.skill.sandalphon.mastered: Sandalphon is mastered: Final Judgment answers you, the judgments cost less, and your passives seal and stutter what they strike.
nusmp.veldanava.skills.title: Will of the Creator
nusmp.veldanava.skills.hint: Choose one ultimate skill. It is yours for good, and it can only be chosen once.
nusmp.veldanava.skills.have: You already hold a skill from the Creator. Take your share of the loot.
